title: Whiskers & Warmth: A Cozy Cat Café Coloring Book for Adults
subtitle: Relaxing Kawaii Scenes with Cute Cats, Warm Drinks & Cozy Interiors
description: Unwind with adorable cats in the coziest café scenes! This relaxing coloring book for adults features charming kawaii cats enjoying warm drinks, pastries, and cozy café interiors. Each page offers medium-detail line art with layered scenes perfect for stress relief and creative relaxation. Grab your favorite coloring tools and step into a world of whiskers and warmth.
keywords: cute cat coloring book stress relief
cover_prompt: A full-color illustration of a cozy cat café scene. A cute kawaii cat with big eyes sits at a small round table, holding a latte with latte art. The café interior has warm tones with wooden shelves lined with books and potted plants, a glowing pendant lamp overhead, a window showing a rainy evening outside. Other small kawaii cats peek from cushioned seats and shelves. Warm, premium cozy aesthetic with soft lighting. DO NOT include any text, letters, or words in the generated image. Professional book cover art style. Coloring Book for Adults.
